If you are dealing with a quality control issue regarding an Experiment Beauty product—or if you suspect your item was switched / counterfeit—taking immediate action through their proper customer support channels is crucial to securing a fast resolution.
1. Identify the Quality vs. "Switched" Issue
Official Purchases: If you bought directly from the Experiment Beauty Store and noticed a strange texture or quality issue, contact them for a standard resolution.
experimentbeauty.com
Third-Party Purchases (Amazon Counterfeits): Experiment Beauty has explicitly warned its community about counterfeit or switched products being sold by unauthorized sellers on platforms like Amazon. If the consistency or packaging feels wrong and you bought it there, you may have received a fake item.
Instagram
·experimentwrld
2. Standard Customer Service Resolution Policy
30-Day Window: Experiment Beauty offers a full refund or replacement within 30 days of purchase.
The Resolution Protocol: To resolve the issue, email their customer support team directly at hey@experimentbeauty.com.
